tanglish: Sliding Window Limiter: 50 requests per 60 seconds per IP. Burst traffic triggers HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
Honeypot Decoys: /.env, /admin, /.git/config routes trap scanners and activate 10-minute auto-ban.

en: AegisGate uses a Sliding-Window Rate Limiter (Default: 50 requests / 60 seconds per IP). Exceeding clients receive HTTP 429 Too Many Requests.
Decoy Honeypots: Routes like /.env, /admin, /wp-login.php, /actuator/env trap malicious scanners (sqlmap, gobuster) and trigger an immediate 10-minute automated client IP ban.
